name: Small Stars Series 2
packaging: Green backpack capsule, one figure inside
packagingNote: Series 2 is the GREEN backpack wave. This is a Mattel Small Stars backpack rather than a Disney Doorables pack, and it holds ONE figure.
sourced: Eight figures, transcribed from Mattel's printed Series 2 display checklist and checked against collector code guides and a photographed complete set. Mattel confirms the product but does not publish each wave's roster, so this remains community-sourced and is not marked verified.
rarityNote: Mattel says each wave has one hard-to-find figure, but the material reviewed does not identify which one, so no rarity is shown.
codeNote: The figure number is printed on the bottom of the backing card after the production batch text. Enter the final number, such as 01. Collectors mapped these codes; Mattel has not published them, so they are unofficial and may differ in another production run.
